concepts.learning_objective: Define absolute humidity and state its unit.
Explain relative humidity and how it changes with temperature.
Explain saturated air and the dew point.
Describe evaporation and the role of latent heat of vaporisation.
Explain how temperature, dryness and air movement affect evaporation.
Explain condensation, condensation nuclei and its causes.
Identify the conditions under which condensation takes place.

topics.title: Forms of condensation: dew, frost, fog and mist

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish dew and frost and the conditions for their formation.
Distinguish fog, mist and smog by visibility, moisture and location.
Identify cirrus, cumulus, stratus and nimbus clouds by height and appearance.
Classify combined cloud types into high, middle, low and vertical-development groups.
Explain how precipitation occurs and its liquid and solid forms.
Distinguish sleet and hailstones by their formation.
Explain the formation and distribution of convectional rain.
Explain orographic rain and the rain-shadow area.
Describe latitudinal, coastal and windward patterns of rainfall distribution.
Classify regions by annual precipitation regime.
